The Probiotics Facial

The only treatment that doesn’t just pamper your skin’s surface but actually feeds and strengthens the living ecosystem on your skin, creating a self-regulating defence system that keeps your complexion calm, resilient, and radiant long after you leave—while most facials focus on immediate results, this one teaches your skin to thrive on its own.

blocks.text: Why this facial is high performing
blocks.html: Why this facial is high performing

This treatment harnesses the innovative Biotics+ Synergy Mask, freshly activated during your session to deliver maximum potency and results. Unlike pre-mixed products that lose efficacy over time, this mask is prepared fresh to ensure the live cultures work at their peak.
PREBIOTICS act as nourishment for your skin’s beneficial bacteria, creating the ideal environment for probiotics to flourish and your skin ecosystem to thrive.
PROBIOTICS are live bacterial cultures that restore balance to your skin’s microbiome, calm inflammation, and actively repair and strengthen your skin barrier from within.

blocks.text: Why Biotics Are Different in Skincare
blocks.html: Why Biotics Are Different in Skincare

Works with your skin, not just on it
Most skincare adds ingredients like hydration, antioxidants, or brightening agents. Biotics go deeper — they work in harmony with your skin’s living microbiome, creating balance at the root for healthier, more resilient skin over time.

Strength that lasts, not just surface glow
While traditional products smooth and soften the outer layer, biotics strengthen your skin’s natural defense system. This means calmer, more hydrated, and better-protected skin that can withstand daily stress.

Teaches your skin to do better
Instead of simply adding or removing (like moisturizers or exfoliants), biotics help your skin self-regulate. By nurturing good bacteria and reducing harmful ones, your skin learns to function at its best — naturally.

Future-proofing your skin health
The results aren’t just immediate. A balanced microbiome helps prevent flare-ups, sensitivity, and premature aging. With biotics, your skin isn’t only glowing today — it’s set up to stay healthier for tomorrow

blocks.text: Who Is The Probiotics Facial For?
blocks.html: Who Is The Probiotics Facial For?

This treatment is designed to work with your unique skin needs and can be fully customized for any skin type. It is also perfect for post-treatment recovery after microneedling, laser, or extractions.

If your skin feels out of balance, stressed, or simply not thriving—this facial helps restore harmony from within.

  • Post-treatment recovery after microneedling, laser, or extractions
  • Dryness and dehydration that won’t go away
  • Sensitivity, redness, or easily irritated skin
  • Breakouts, congestion, or acne-prone skin
  • Uneven tone and dullness
  • Early signs of aging and loss of firmness
The Probiotic Facial Experience

1. Skin Consultation & Analysis

Your therapist begins with a careful assessment of your skin to recommend the most suitable mask.

2. Double Cleansing & Exfoliation

Impurities and dead skin cells are gently removed, allowing active ingredients to penetrate more effectively.

3. Repair & Boosting

An ampoule customized to your skin type, is applied to replenish and strengthen.

4. Prebiotic & Probiotic Mask Ritual

A fresh hydrogel mask is activated with a live prebiotic capsule and applied within minutes, delivering maximum potency to rebalance and fortify the skin.

5. Rest & Restore

While the mask works deeply to hydrate and calm, enjoy a moment of pure relaxation as your skin regains its natural balance.

6. Revealing Radiance

The mask is gently lifted away, unveiling refreshed, radiant skin. The treatment concludes with aftercare to lock in results.
Frequently Asked Questions

• What makes the Probiotics Facial different from other facials?

    Unlike traditional facials that only work on the surface, this treatment nourishes your skin’s living microbiome. By balancing good and bad bacteria, it strengthens your skin barrier, calms irritation, and helps your complexion stay healthy long after the session.

  • Is the Probiotics Facial suitable for all skin types?

    Yes — it can be customized for dry, oily, combination, sensitive, or reactive skin. It is especially beneficial for skin that feels stressed, imbalanced, or prone to flare-ups.

  • Can I do this facial after microneedling or laser treatments?

    Absolutely. The Probiotics Facial is ideal for post-treatment recovery. It soothes inflammation, restores hydration, and supports the skin barrier, making it a perfect companion after procedures like microneedling, laser, or extractions.

  • What skin concerns does this facial help with?

    This treatment addresses dryness, sensitivity, redness, breakouts, congestion, uneven tone, dullness, and early signs of aging. It’s designed to restore balance so your skin can function and look its best.

  • How is the Probiotic & Prebiotic Mask prepared?

    The hydrogel mask is freshly mixed with a live prebiotic capsule during your session. This ensures the live cultures are at peak potency, delivering maximum benefits to your skin.

  • What results can I expect after one session?

    You’ll notice calmer, hydrated, and more radiant skin immediately. With regular treatments, your skin becomes stronger, more resilient, and less prone to sensitivity, breakouts, and premature aging.

  • How often should I do the Probiotics Facial?

    For best results, we recommend once every 3–4 weeks. Consistency helps your skin maintain balance and strengthens its natural defenses over time.

  • Is the facial relaxing or more results-driven?

    Both. While the mask works to rebalance your skin from within, you’ll also enjoy a calming relaxation phase, making this facial as restorative for the senses as it is for the skin.
